ios.desc:
Never lose track of what's in which box again. SmartBox is a home inventory, packing list, and label maker in one — print a QR label, scan it later, and find any item in seconds.

SCAN & LABEL
• Print QR labels for every box, then scan to open it instantly
• Read and write NFC tags for hands-free identification
• Share or bulk-print QR codes and custom barcodes

ORGANIZE EVERYTHING
• Snap a photo and let AI list the box's contents for you
• Add boxes and items with photos, quantities, weights, and color tags
• Build reusable packing lists for moves, trips, and seasonal storage
• Handling labels: Fragile, This Side Up, Keep Dry, and more

FIND IN SECONDS
• Fuzzy search across all boxes, items, and tags
• Spotlight search — find your stuff from the iOS Home Screen
• Home-Screen widgets, Control Center buttons, and Siri shortcuts

TRACK & PROTECT
• Store warranties and get reminded before they expire
• Dashboard totals; sort by name, date, quantity, or weight
• Export your whole inventory as PDF or CSV

BACK UP
• Automatic iCloud sync keeps everything safe across devices
• Full backup and restore

Perfect for moving, home organization, decluttering, storage units, garages, pantries, closets, and warehouses.
